title.value: A guided multiverse study of neuroimaging analyses
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: A guided multiverse study of neuroimaging analyses

analysis.description: The paper presents a framework for navigating and analyzing the multiverse of analytic choices in neuroimaging studies, utilizing active learning to efficiently explore low-dimensional spaces of analysis pipelines. The approach is demonstrated using two functional MRI datasets, focusing on predicting brain age and autism diagnosis.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical results from analyzing two functional MRI datasets using multiverse analyses, demonstrating the practical application and performance of the proposed framework.
type.quote: We illustrate this approach with two functional MRI datasets (predicting brain age and autism diagnosis) demonstrating how a multiverse of analyses can be efficiently navigated and mapped out using active learning.

name.justification: The research focuses on analyzing neuroimaging data, specifically functional MRI datasets, using a multiverse approach to explore different analysis pipelines.
name.quote: For most neuroimaging questions the range of possible analytic choices makes it unclear how to evaluate conclusions from any single analytic method.

name.justification: The study specifically utilizes functional MRI data to explore the multiverse of analytic pipelines.
name.quote: We illustrate this approach with two functional MRI datasets (predicting brain age and autism diagnosis) demonstrating how a multiverse of analyses can be efficiently navigated and mapped out using active learning.

name.justification: The study employs machine learning techniques like Bayesian optimization and active learning to navigate and analyze the analytic space.
name.quote: This machine learning approach is flexible and the choice of how exploratory (mapping the space in detail) or exploitative (finding the best workflow with as few samples as possible) can be adapted depending on the research objective.

name.justification: The paper uses age prediction as one of the regression problems to demonstrate its framework.
name.quote: Regression analysis. The first step is to construct a low-dimensional space from the analytic space. Figure 1 illustrates the space obtained using MDS.

name.justification: The paper conducts a classification problem, distinguishing between autistic individuals and healthy controls using the proposed analysis framework.
name.quote: We also explored how the multiverse approach could be used when distinguishing between autistic people and controls.

name.justification: Graph theoretical metrics are used as part of the analytic pipelines for neuroimaging data analysis.
name.quote: The graph theoretical metric studied: we consider 16 distinct simple and higher-level features of network organization.

name.justification: Support Vector Regression is explicitly mentioned as used for predicting age in the regression analysis section.
name.quote: When a point in the space is selected, the closest analysis approach to that point in the space is selected and its predictive accuracy evaluated by using support vector regression for the brain age prediction.

is_contributed.justification: SVR is a known model and is used here for regression purposes, not contributed by this paper.
is_contributed.quote: When a point in the space is selected, the closest analysis approach to that point in the space is selected and its predictive accuracy evaluated by using support vector regression for the brain age prediction.
